# Table cells (#246)

Double-click a word in any cell below: only that word is selected, never the
cells beside it. Select a whole row and copy it, and it pastes into a
spreadsheet as separate columns.

Plain words for control: Alpha Bravo Charlie.

| Delta | Echo | Foxtrot |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Golf | Hotel | India |
| `code` | **bold** | [link](https://example.com) |
| 中文 | 日本語 | 한국어 |

> A quote after the table, with *emphasis*.

- A list item after the table
- Another, with `inline code`

```text
A code block closes the fixture.
```
